description: MUTATES Scalingo infrastructure — sets the container formation (number and/or size of each process type). Only the container types you include are changed. Returns 202 Accepted (track via get_operation). Scalingo API: POST /v1/apps/{app}/scale.

app.description: The app name (e.g. my-production-app) or app id (app-…).

containers.description: Formation entries to apply. Each entry needs a name plus amount and/or size.

amount.description: Number of containers of this type.

name: scale_app
title: Scale app
